response.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.healtheval AS health_safety_status, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS average_gb_per_minute, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.healtheval), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_gb_per_minute) AS mean_average FROM site_groups) SELECT g.site_code, g.health_safety_status, g.average_gb_per_minute, g.scan_count, g.average_gb_per_minute - m.mean_average AS amount_above_mean FROM site_groups AS g CROSS JOIN group_mean AS m WHERE g.average_gb_per_minute > m.mean_average ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
